1.consolidated_definition: Prendas de vestir propias para ocasiones como los bautismos. “Me puse/ los trapos de cristianay/ y, ey malambo ebajo er braso.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Attire specifically designed for occasions such as baptisms. "I wore the Christian clothes and a malambo under my arm."
